name: UNH Tech Camp Durham – Week 1
operator_name: University of New Hampshire Youth Programs (College of Engineering and Physical Sciences)
description_short: A one-week STEM program at UNH for students entering grades 5–12, with hands-on tracks in RC car engineering, regenerative medicine labs, bioinformatics, and MATLAB heat modeling. Commuter and overnight options are offered for most tracks.
refund_policy_summary: Drop/transfer requests made 15 or more days before the session starts get a refund minus an administrative fee of at least $75. No refund for requests made 14 or fewer days before the start or later. Full refund if UNH cancels the session. A $10 registration fee (once per student) is non-refundable.

This page is for the Summer 2026 season (July 13–17, 2026), which is already over as of today (2026-10-13). No 2027 dates or prices are posted, and the page says "This course is currently unavailable."
Registration for 2026 closed June 12, 2026. Session availability is shown only for TechSplorers (FULL).

price_per_week is set to the most common commuter rate ($1,300). Actual rates by track are $500 (TechSplorers), $1,300/$2,100 (TechVenturers commuter/overnight), and $1,500/$2,300 (TechLeaders commuter/overnight).
A non-refundable $10 registration fee per student is charged at checkout on top of the program fee.
A 25% deposit option was offered (until April 1, 2026) but is optional. Otherwise, full payment is due at enrollment.
Eligibility is by grade entering fall, not age. The Heat Equation track requires prior completion of Algebra I.
Camp is single-focus STEM but offers both day (commuter, 8:30am–4:00pm) and overnight options.
